user.title: Pair AC with room thermometer
user.description: Choose a native SwitchBot Cloud AC and a temperature sensor. This creates a local presentation entity; it never adjusts the AC automatically. Export this paired entity to HomeKit and exclude the original AC. A missing sensor makes this entity unavailable instead of displaying a default room temperature.

error.invalid_source: Select a registered native SwitchBot Cloud AC and a Celsius or Fahrenheit temperature sensor.

abort.already_configured: This AC is already paired. Use Configure to change its sensor.

init.title: Change room temperature sensor
init.description: Changing the thermometer preserves this AC entity and HomeKit pairing. Saving does not send an AC command. If a sensor is unavailable, this paired entity becomes unavailable; you can still control the native AC directly in HA or Dashboard.

error.invalid_source: Select a registered temperature sensor with Celsius or Fahrenheit units.
